article.title: Counter-claim to be stated.
article.content: Where any defendant seeks to rely upon any ground as supporting a right of counter-claim, he shall, in his written statement, state specifically that he does so by way of counter-claim.
article.html:
6BCounter-claim to be stated.

Order 8, Rule 6B

Where any defendant seeks to rely upon any ground as supporting a right of counter-claim, he shall, in his written statement, state specifically that he does so by way of counter-claim.
